died.name: Béla I of Hungary
died.cause: After the Holy Roman Empire decided to launch a military expedition against Hungary to restore his nephew Solomon to the throne, the Hungarian king was seriously injured when "his throne broke beneath him" in his manor at Dömös, later succumbing at a creek near Nagykanizsa.

died.name: Rolf Mützelburg
died.cause: The 29-year-old commander of German submarine U-203 died during a World War II patrol southwest of the Azores when he dived from the sub's conning tower to swim in the ocean. The boat lurched suddenly, and Mützelburg's head and shoulder struck the sub.

died.name: Muhammad Ali Jinnah
died.cause: on being told by his doctor, Lieutenant Colonel Ilahi Bakhsh, that he was going to live. He died thirty minutes later

died.name: Salvador Allende Gossens
died.cause: addressing the nation during the 1973 Chilean coup d'état moments before killing himself
died.last_words: These are my last words, and I am certain that my sacrifice will not be in vain. I am certain that, at the very least, it will be a moral lesson that will punish felony, cowardice and treason.

died.name: Georgi Markov
died.cause: The Bulgarian dissident writer was poisoned on a London street via a micro-engineered pellet containing ricin, fired into his leg from an umbrella wielded by an assassin associated with the Bulgarian Secret Service. Markov died four days later in hospital. No one was ever charged with the assassination.

born.name: Henri de La Tour d'Auvergne, Viscount of Turenne
born.cause: struck by a cannonball at the Battle of Salzbach
born.last_words: I did not mean to be killed today.

born.name: Ulrica Eleanor the Elder
born.last_words: Yes, like that, just like that, my royal friend, raise me upward, upward!

born.name: Johann Bernhard Basedow
born.desc: German educational reformer, teacher and writer
born.last_words: I desire to be dissected for the benefit of my fellow men.

born.name: O. Henry
born.last_words: Pull up the shades; I don't want to go home in the dark.

born.name: Frederick Funston
born.desc: United States Army general and Medal of Honor recipient
born.cause: while listening to an orchestra play "The Blue Danube" waltz in the lobby of The St. Anthony Hotel in San Antonio, Texas. He then collapsed from a heart attack

born.name: D. H. Lawrence
born.last_words: I think it is time for morphine.

born.name: Helen Palmer
born.desc: American children's author, editor and philanthropist
born.cause: in her suicide note, addressed to her husband, Theodor "Dr. Seuss" Geisel
born.last_words: Dear Ted, what has happened to us? I don't know. I feel myself in a spiral, going down down down, into a black hole from which there is no escape, no brightness. And loud in my ears from every side I hear, 'failure, failure, failure...' I love you so much ... I am too old and enmeshed in everything you do and are, that I cannot conceive of life without you ... My going will leave quite a rumor but you can say I was overworked and overwrought. Your reputation with your friends and fans will not be harmed ... Sometimes think of the fun we had all thru the years ...

born.name: William Schaffner
born.cause: prior to his BAC Lightning crashing into the North Sea; some commentators would allege that a UFO was involved in the incident
